services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: This seasonal experience combines live music, stunning Mississippi River sunset views, and a laid‑back atmosphere aboard the historic Cassville Ferry. It’s the perfect way to relax, unwind, and enjoy an unforgettable evening on the water. Guests walk on with a lawn chair, bring their own drinks and snacks, and sit back-or dance along-during a two‑hour cruise across the Mississippi River while soaking in golden‑hour views. 🚨 Tickets are $15 each and go on sale April 15th at 8am. Tickets are limited and sell quickly! Only 147 tickets are available per cruise, and payment is due at the time of reservation. Please note: Do NOT send personal messages to the Ferry’s Facebook page to purchase

services.name: ATV Adventures
services.desc: Load up your machine and explore Cassville and the surrounding areas, where your ATV/UTV adventure awaits! Are you traveling from across the river? The Pride of Cassville Ferry welcomes ATV/UTVs aboard. Ride through local routes, cruising along paved, and unpaved township roads, soaking in the beauty of the driftless area. Our entire Village is open ATV/UTV route (excluding alleyways) with the preferred route as HWY 133/Amelia St. All children under the age of 18 must have a minima DOT Standard motorcycle or ATV Helmet. Bicycle helmets are NOT Legal. WI Law require those who use WI ATV/UTV Trails to display either WI registration or a Nonresident Trail

services.name: Cabins - Resorts - Motels
services.desc: Discover the perfect getaway in Cassville with our selection of cabins, resorts, and motels. Whether you’re looking for adventure or relaxation, enjoy stunning river views, modern amenities, and cozy accommodations. Experience the best Cassville has to offer while staying at our family-friendly lodging options. Book now and make your trip

services.name: Vacation Rentals
services.desc: This is our family's home away from home. Complete access to the river with a fantastic swim dock, boat slip and 4 jet ski docks, bring your boat or rent one just down the street. Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Less than a block to J&J Supper club and the library. Four blocks to the boat launch. Ten blocks to downtown. Escape to our 2 x luxurious Serenity log mansions, sleeping 31 people. Boasting in total a size of over 16,000 sq. ft, offering an amazing 3,000 square feet of porch space in each with endless infinity views of the Mississippi River. Located next to each other and are in excellent condition, featuring large, open floor plan spaces that is perfect
